suggested_experiments.title: Investigate no-New-Pump-signal missed movers
suggested_experiments.description: 20 strong movers were in the universe but had no L34/FRI34/G4/B2 signal. Breakdown: bearish reversal (SPRING_REVERSAL): 7, no NP condition met (BREAKOUT_ORPHAN): 7, extreme compression (QUIET_BASE): 4, already running (PARABOLIC): 2. 18 may be addressable with signal extensions (SPRING/QUIET/ORPHAN). Review bar-level anatomy to see if a new signal pattern is being missed.
